+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = r'''
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.10"
+author: Ruckus Wireless (@Commscope)
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Manage logging destinations and levels on Ruckus ICX switches.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination to configure.
+    choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, facility, on]
+    type: str
+  name:
+    description: Syslog host name or IP address.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a syslog host.
+    type: int
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility name.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Buffered severity level or console level.
+    type: raw
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging configurations to apply together.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+  state:
+    description: Whether the configuration should be present or absent.
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+    type: str
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Read the running configuration; can be set with ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG.
+    type: bool
+    default: yes
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Configure IPv6 syslog server and facility
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: host, name: "2001:db8::10", udp_port: 514}
+      - {dest: facility, facility: local7}
+- name: Disable buffered debugging logs
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: buffered
+    level: debugging
+    state: absent
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands generated for the device.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+'''
+
+import ipaddress
+import re
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_v6_address
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+
+BUFFER_LEVELS = ('alerts', 'critical', 'debugging', 'emergencies', 'errors',
+                 'informational', 'notifications', 'warnings')
+DESTINATIONS = ('host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'facility', 'on')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    """Count supplied values among the requested parameter names."""
+    if isinstance(check, dict):
+        params = check
+        names = param if param is not None else check.keys()
+    else:
+        names = check
+        params = param or {}
+    return sum(1 for name in names if params.get(name) is not None)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    """Validate parameter dependencies using required_if-style rules."""
+    if spec:
+        for condition in spec:
+            key, value, required = condition[:3]
+            if param.get(key) == value:
+                missing = [name for name in required if param.get(name) is None]
+                if missing:
+                    module.fail_json(msg="%s is required when %s is %s" % (', '.join(missing), key, value))
+    dest = param.get('dest')
+    if dest == 'host' and not param.get('name'):
+        module.fail_json(msg="name is required when dest is 'host'")
+    if dest == 'buffered' and param.get('level') is None:
+        module.fail_json(msg="level is required when dest is 'buffered'")
+    if dest == 'facility' and not param.get('facility'):
+        module.fail_json(msg="facility is required when dest is 'facility'")
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    objects = []
+    common = module.params
+    aggregate = common.get('aggregate')
+    entries = aggregate if aggregate else [common]
+    for entry in entries:
+        item = dict((key, entry.get(key, common.get(key))) for key in
+                    ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state'))
+        item['state'] = item.get('state') or common.get('state') or 'present'
+        check_required_if(module, required_if, item)
+        dest = item.get('dest')
+        if dest not in DESTINATIONS:
+            module.fail_json(msg="dest must be one of %s" % ', '.join(DESTINATIONS))
+        item['addr6'] = False
+        if dest == 'host':
+            try:
+                ip = ipaddress.ip_address(item['name'])
+                item['addr6'] = ip.version == 6
+                if item['addr6']:
+                    validate_ip_v6_address(item['name'])
+            except ValueError:
+                # Hostnames are supported; validate only strings that look like IPv6.
+                if ':' in item['name']:
+                    module.fail_json(msg="Invalid IPv6 address: %s" % item['name'])
+            item['udp_port'] = str(item['udp_port']) if item['udp_port'] is not None else None
+        else:
+            item['name'] = None
+            item['udp_port'] = None
+        if dest == 'buffered':
+            level = item['level']
+            levels = level if isinstance(level, (list, tuple, set)) else [level]
+            invalid = [str(value) for value in levels if value not in BUFFER_LEVELS]
+            if invalid:
+                module.fail_json(msg='Invalid buffered level: %s' % ', '.join(invalid))
+            item['level'] = set(levels)
+        elif dest == 'console' and item['level'] is not None:
+            item['level'] = str(item['level'])
+        else:
+            item['level'] = None
+        objects.append(item)
+    return objects
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest != 'host':
+        return None
+    match = re.search(r'\budp-port\s+(\d+)\b', line)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest != 'host':
+        return None
+    match = re.match(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+(?:ipv6\s+)?([^\s]+)', line)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.match(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+ipv6\s+', line))
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    config = get_config(module, flags=['| include logging']) or ''
+    objects = []
+    facility = None
+    buffered = set()
+    disabled_buffered = set()
+    for raw_line in config.splitlines():
+        line = raw_line.strip()
+        if not line:
+            continue
+        if line.startswith('logging host '):
+            name = parse_name(line, 'host')
+            objects.append({'dest': 'host', 'name': name, 'addr6': parse_address(line, 'host'),
+                            'udp_port': parse_port(line, 'host'), 'state': 'present'})
+        elif line == 'logging console':
+            objects.append({'dest': 'console', 'level': None, 'state': 'present'})
+        elif line == 'no logging console':
+            objects = [obj for obj in objects if obj.get('dest') != 'console']
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in BUFFER_LEVELS:
+                buffered.add(level)
+                disabled_buffered.discard(level)
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in BUFFER_LEVELS:
+                buffered.discard(level)
+                disabled_buffered.add(level)
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split()[-1]
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = None
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            objects.append({'dest': 'persistence', 'state': 'present'})
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            objects.append({'dest': 'rfc5424', 'state': 'present'})
+        elif line == 'logging on':
+            pass
+        elif line == 'no logging on':
+            objects.append({'dest': 'on', 'state': 'absent'})
+    objects.append({'dest': 'facility', 'facility': facility or 'user', 'state': 'present'})
+    objects.append({'dest': 'buffered', 'level': buffered, 'disabled_level': disabled_buffered,
+                    'state': 'present'})
+    if not any(obj.get('dest') == 'on' for obj in objects):
+        objects.append({'dest': 'on', 'state': 'present'})
+    return objects
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for obj in lst:
+        if obj.get('name') == name:
+            return obj
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    wanted = set(want.get('level') or ())
+    present = set(have.get('level') or ())
+    return wanted - present, present - wanted
+
+
+def _find(have, dest):
+    for obj in have:
+        if obj.get('dest') == dest:
+            return obj
+    return None
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for item in want:
+        dest, state = item['dest'], item['state']
+        current = _find(have, dest)
+        if dest == 'host':
+            found = next((obj for obj in have if obj.get('dest') == 'host' and
+                          obj.get('name') == item['name'] and obj.get('addr6') == item['addr6'] and
+                          (item.get('udp_port') is None or obj.get('udp_port') == item.get('udp_port'))), None)
+            if state == 'present' and found is None:
+                address = ('ipv6 ' if item['addr6'] else '') + item['name']
+                command = 'logging host %s' % address
+                if item.get('udp_port'):
+                    command += ' udp-port %s' % item['udp_port']
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent':
+                matches = [obj for obj in have if obj.get('dest') == 'host' and obj.get('name') == item['name']
+                           and obj.get('addr6') == item['addr6']]
+                for obj in matches:
+                    address = ('ipv6 ' if obj.get('addr6') else '') + obj['name']
+                    command = 'no logging host %s' % address
+                    port = item.get('udp_port') or obj.get('udp_port')
+                    if port:
+                        command += ' udp-port %s' % port
+                    commands.append(command)
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            have_item = current or {'level': set(), 'disabled_level': set()}
+            adds, removes = diff_in_list(item, have_item)
+            if state == 'absent':
+                adds, removes = set(), set(item['level']) & set(have_item.get('level') or ())
+                # A specific absent level means emit the explicit ICX disable command.
+                existing_disabled = set(have_item.get('disabled_level') or ())
+                commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(set(item['level']) - existing_disabled))
+                continue
+            commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(adds))
+            commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(removes))
+        elif dest == 'facility':
+            actual = current.get('facility') if current else 'user'
+            if state == 'absent':
+                if actual != 'user':
+                    commands.append('no logging facility')
+            elif item.get('facility') != actual:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % item['facility'])
+        elif dest in ('console', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on'):
+            enabled = state == 'present'
+            if dest == 'on':
+                # Global logging is enabled by default; represent disabled state explicitly.
+                is_enabled = not current or current.get('state') != 'absent'
+                if enabled != is_enabled:
+                    commands.append('logging on' if enabled else 'no logging on')
+            elif dest == 'console':
+                is_enabled = current is not None
+                if enabled != is_enabled:
+                    commands.append('logging console' if enabled else 'no logging console')
+            else:
+                is_enabled = current is not None
+                if enabled != is_enabled:
+                    commands.append(('logging persistence' if dest == 'persistence' else 'logging enable rfc5424')
+                                    if enabled else ('no logging persistence' if dest == 'persistence'
+                                                     else 'no logging enable rfc5424'))
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    fields = dict(dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS), name=dict(type='str'),
+                  udp_port=dict(type='int'), facility=dict(type='str'), level=dict(),
+                  aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict'),
+                  state=dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']),
+                  check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                            fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(fields)
+    aggregate_spec.pop('aggregate')
+    aggregate_spec.pop('check_running_config')
+    fields['aggregate'] = dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=fields, supports_check_mode=True)
+    required_if = [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, required_if)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module) if module.params['check_running_config'] else []
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    result = {'changed': bool(commands), 'commands': commands}
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(**result)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
